text.p: Here are highlights of stories in Skopje press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified them nor does it vouch for their accuracy.
- Macedonian parliament passed a law on religious organisations and religious groups.
- Macedonia and Italy signed in Rome an agreement on driving licences according to which Macedonian driving licences will be valid for a year in Italy and then have to be replaced for Italian.
- Albanian PDP party MP's will return to the parliament when republic's Interior Minister Tomislav Cokrevski reports on Gostivar riots which occured last Wednesday.
- Spokesperson of the ruling SDSM Radmila Shekerinska told a news conference on Wednesday that the police action in Gostivar was well performed.

- PDP president Abdurahman Aliti met the top officials of the Albanian ruling socialists in Tirana Fatos Nano and Bashkim Fino who applauded the peaceful manner in which PDP is trying to resolve the inter-ethnic problems in Macedonia.

- PDP officials announce crisis of the coalition with the ruling SDSM saying that the republic's Prime MInister Branko Crvenkovski undertakes actions behind the back of its coalition partner. Ethnic Albanian ministers were not informed that the police would intervene in Gostivar.
- The SDSM announces an initiative for resignation of Bitola mayor Siljan Micevksi due to his involvement in the TAT financial scandal.
